title: CodeAssay: A Multi-Metric Benchmark with Audited Ground Truth for LLM Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.03535v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models are increasingly evaluated for code generation using test-based benchmarks. The validity of such evaluations depends on the reliability of their references and tests, while test-based correctness captures only part of the observable properties of generated code. We present CodeAssay, a taxonomy-first benchmark of 185 Python tasks across ten software-engineering categories. It combines audited ground truth, public tests for generation and repair, hidden tests for grading, mutation-based test-suite validation, and selected code-property measures. Regrading fixed model outputs after the audit changed 170 of 1,890 correctness labels (9.0%) and increased the measured best-to-worst model spread from 11.9 to 23.7 percentage points, although aggregate correctness remained nearly unchanged. translated_title: CodeAssay：一个具有经审计真实基准的面向大语言模型代码生成的多指标评测基准
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地通过基于测试的基准来评估其代码生成能力。此类评估的有效性取决于参考答案和测试的可靠性，而基于测试的正确性判定仅能捕捉生成代码可观察属性的一部分。我们提出了CodeAssay，这是一个以分类体系为先的基准，涵盖十个软件工程类别下的185个Python任务。它结合了经过审计的真实基准、用于代码生成与修复的公开测试、用于评分的隐藏测试、基于变异的测试套件验证以及精选的代码属性度量。在审计之后对固定的模型输出重新评分，改变了1,890个正确性标签中的170个（9.0%），并将测得的最好与最差模型之间的性能差距从11.9个百分点扩大到23.7个百分点，尽管总体正确性几乎保持不变。完整测试套件和隐藏测试套件的变异得分分别达到82.6%和74.8%。在七个专有大语言模型上，标准……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: CodeAssay是一个包含十个软件工程类别185个Python任务的多指标代码生成评测基准，其经审计的真实基准使9%的正确性标签发生变化，并将模型间性能差距从11.9扩大到23.7个百分点，揭示了现有基于测试的评估方式的可靠性问题。
en_tdlr: CodeAssay is a taxonomy-first, multi-metric benchmark of 185 Python tasks with audited ground truth, demonstrating that regrading after audit changed 9% of correctness labels and nearly doubled the measured best-to-worst model spread, revealing reliability issues in existing test-based LLM code evaluation.
